title: Rabbi Abba bar Binyamin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Vayikra Rabbah 10:5, Rabbi Acha and Rabbi Avin bar Binyamin say in the name of Rabbi Abba: “Great is the power of repentance: it nullifies a decree and annuls an oath.” The saying is repeated in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6 and Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, at the historical folio locator 163a, where the name is Rabbi Acha bar Avin bar Binyamin; Hyman says it should read as in Vayikra Rabbah. In Midrash Mishlei 15:17, Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba says that Rabbi Avin bar Binyamin spoke in the name of Rabbi Yose ben Zimra.

notes.text: Hyman proposes separating the fused “Acha bar Avin bar Binyamin” into Acha and Avin bar Binyamin. The entry metadata says Abba bar Binyamin, while the quoted chain names Avin bar Binyamin.
